name: work-experience
title: Work Experience List
blurb: Animated work history timeline with company logos, roles, and skills tags.
description: Displays chronological work experience with staggered entrance animations. Shows company logo, role, period, location, description, and skill tags. Includes footer statistics. Uses Framer Motion for timing.
use_when: Portfolio or resume pages showing professional history and accomplishments.
avoid_when: Dynamic or user-provided content; component contains hardcoded work history data.
a11y: Timeline is semantic divs. Images have alt text. SVG icons have no aria labels; depends on visual context.
